🚨Gavin Newsom wins a key round in his $787M defamation case against Fox News.

A judge ruled it’s “reasonably conceivable” Fox knowingly aired false claims about Newsom’s call with Donald Trump and denied their motion to dismiss.

The case now heads to trial.

Newsom: “Looking forward to discovery.”

They should be issuing a tsunami warning. Because when gas hits $5 a gallon, elections don’t go the way people in power think they will.

And yet, you’ve got Republicans giving Trump an A on the economy. An A.

With prices surging. They see the wave coming. They’re just pretending it’s not there.

NEWS: Hakeem Jeffries says Democrats are eyeing at least FOUR STATES for potential new congressional maps ahead of 2028—setting up a major redistricting battle to counter expected GOP gerrymanders after the Supreme Court gutted key Voting Rights Act protections.

Iran's Ayatollah just said Americans belong "at the bottom" of the Persian Gulf.

Trump responded by posting QAnon memes and complaining about Jimmy Kimmel.

Inflation hit a 3-year high. Oil broke $120/barrel. A GOP congressman gave Trump an "E for effort" on the economy.

Full midday recap is up.
Nobody understands how the global oil market works like Burchett. bsky.app/profile/meid...

MeidasTouch: Do you think Donald Trump has kept his promise to lower prices?

McCormick: Yeah. You know how expensive it is if we get attacked by a foreign enemy, and especially if they have nuclear arms, it can disrupt the whole Middle East. That would affected us a lot more in the long term.

Rep. Byron Donalds (R-FL) says Donald Trump has delivered on his promise to lower prices and gets an “A” on the economy.

MeidasTouch: Do you think Donald Trump has delivered on his promise to lower prices?

Donalds: Yeah, he actually has. I remember where we were with the Biden administration.

Rep. McCormick (R-GA) says he doesn’t worry about high gas prices because we don’t rely on oil from the Strait of Hormuz, and blames Biden.

McCormick: If we had the pipeline that we didn't complete thanks to the Biden administration for so long, we'd be in a much better position

Rep. Newhouse (R-WA) gives Trump an 'E' for effort on the economy.

MeidasTouch: Do you think that Donald Trump has delivered on his promise to lower prices?

Newhouse: He's working on it.

MeidasTouch: What grade would you give him?

Newhouse: At least a satisfactory or an 'E' for effort.

Rep. Glenn Ivey (D-MD) tells @macfarlanenews.bsky.social the lawyers who filed the Comey case should be sanctioned.

Ivey: I think the lawyers who are pushing these kinds of cases really should be held accountable.

Rep. Burchett (R-TN) refuses to put any blame on Trump for high gas prices.

Burchett: It has to do with the greed of the oil companies. We buy zero oil from Iran. 90% of their oil they sell to China. They're just gouging us. And I blame Congress.

Rep. Babin (R-TX) confronts our reporter and demands to know who he is with after first running past him when asked if Trump has kept his promise to lower prices.

Babin: We saw the prices come down dramatically!

MeidasTouch: : What grade would you give Trump on the economy?

Babin: He's got a B
